min_answer_support_why: At least half of the correct answer's content words must appear in the quote. A quote that proves an answer normally restates it, and half leaves room for a paraphrase of the rest. Set from this reasoning before the v3 replay was run, and not adjusted question by question.
extra_stop_words: all any as at been being both but each had has have if no not so such than then there these those was were
alias_rule: A concept's name always counts. An alias counts only if no other concept claims it and it is either several words or a single word with a capital after its first letter (BST, AVL, SLList). So ordinary-word aliases such as Add, Tree or general never count.
mention_rule: The source must contain the words the question used, or the concept's own name. Another alias is not enough, because aliases are noisy: stack has the alias SLList, so a chunk about SLList does not prove a question about a stack.
